info.title: Deals & Promotions API
info.description: Mode C API of Deals & Promotions (SSPS v1): automatic offers without codes for any catalog. All data lives in the merchant's own database. Money is integer minor units + ISO-4217 currency; times are ISO-8601 UTC; deal windows are local time in the deal's or website's zone. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). `Idempotency-Key` is optional; creating deals, quotes and price locks refuses a repeated key (409 duplicate_request), and committing a quote again for the same order answers the original application. Browser (`pk_`) calls identify the shopper with `SS-Identity` (the website's own login token).

get.summary: List deals (not archived unless ?status=archived), with usage and whether each is live now.

post.summary: Create a deal. The kind's element must be on (403 kind_disabled); bounds come from the website's configuration (422 validation_failed, 409 deal_limit_reached).
Validate a deal without saving it: field errors, rules@1 diagnostics of its conditions, and its schedule state now.

patch.summary: JSON Merge Patch of a deal (kind is immutable; 409 conflict on a concurrent change).

delete.summary: Archive a deal (soft delete; committed history stays).

post.summary: Quote a cart: item deals, bundles, cart deals and free shipping under the stacking policy, price locks honoured, upsell hints. Stored for commit (quote_ttl_minutes); metered (`quote`); rate limited (429 + Retry-After). pk_ (browser, the shopper from SS-Identity) or sk_.

Commit a quote to an order: counts uses, stock and per-customer usage atomically (409 deal_exhausted, quote_expired, quote_committed, total_mismatch), records the application, publishes deals.applied@1 (and deals.exhausted@1). Replays for the same order return 200.
Release a committed quote (cancelled order): uses and stock are given back once. order.cancelled@1 does the same.

put.summary: Upsert an item in the catalog mirror (collections, brand, attributes, price, cost, stock, variants). Quotes fill what a cart line does not send from here.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the mirror (soft).

post.summary: Upsert up to quote_api.max_batch_items items; per-item results.

get.summary: Offers for synced items (product cards): ?items=itm_1,itm_2:var_1&currency=EUR. Price after unconditional item deals, badge, pills, countdown. Metered (`quote`, one per request), rate limited.

post.summary: Offers for items with their prices and attributes in the body (no catalog sync needed); optionally with price locks.
Lock the shown price of items for price_locks.ttl_minutes (signed tokens; bound to the identified shopper when configured). Pass the tokens back in POST /v1/quotes `locks`.
What a lock token holds and whether it is still valid.

get.summary: The deals page: live (and upcoming) deals sorted by configuration, each with an item preview priced with today's deals.
More items of one deal on the deals page.
Orders with deals, discount given, revenue, average order with/without deals (uplift), margin impact (items with cost), per-deal uses and units. ?from=&to= (default reporting.window_days).
What this website has enabled (from the cached signed document).

post.summary: Element/domain events the website pushes into this product.
